description: View and click tracker templates returned by the official IMA single-inline sample tag. Opaque xai, sai and sig are retained; completeness warnings do not validate cryptographic signatures or unpublished variants.

params.name: xai
params.description: Nonempty opaque signed field in the official IMA sample response. Only template completeness is observable.

params.name: sai
params.description: Nonempty opaque signed field in the official IMA sample response. Only template completeness is observable.

params.name: sig
params.description: Nonempty opaque signed field in the official IMA sample response. Only template completeness is observable.

params.name: adurl
params.description: Optional source-generated callback field. Empty adurl is explicitly emitted by the official view template.

params.name: uach_m
params.description: Optional source-generated callback field. Empty adurl is explicitly emitted by the official view template.

params.name: fbs_aeid
params.description: Optional source-generated callback field. Empty adurl is explicitly emitted by the official view template.
